purpose: Single source of truth for tick-accurate runtime work: ASM references, Python entrypoints, current confidence, blind spots, and regression tests.

status_legend.asm_verified: The runtime behavior is intentionally matched to a concrete ASM branch/address and covered by enough checks for current use.
status_legend.asm_partial: The runtime behavior has ASM evidence, but timing, edge cases, or state transitions are still incomplete.
status_legend.data_verified: Data/asset mapping is confirmed, but runtime behavior is not fully traced.
status_legend.heuristic: Implemented from observation or inference, not yet backed by concrete ASM.
status_legend.known_wrong: A mismatch against the original is known and documented.

phases.title: Mission fixed DOS tick ordering
exact_claims: One DOS tick snapshots dynamic render positions before simulation mutation.
When DS:69F5/DS:69F6 death state is active, the death branch runs before actor updates instead of freezing actors.
The moving-platform carry branch can still catch the death sprite after the death arc mutates Y on the same tick.
blind_spots: The full mission loop around 0x1B5D is not yet represented as a named phase table.
The restart helper at 0x520:0x011A is still only partially understood, so tick-order after death expiration is approximate.
Some interaction dispatch inside update_player_interactions is still broad and should be split into exact subphases.
next_actions: Trace the post-0x1B5D actor/update call chain into a named tick phase map.
Split update_player_interactions into ordered ASM-backed subdispatchers.
Trace 0x520:0x011A persistence/game-over behavior.

phases.title: Hard-death bounce arc and clamp
exact_claims: DS:69F6 starts at 0x23 and indexes a signed word table.
The table value is subtracted from player Y, so positive values move up and negative values move down.
Y clamps between 0x10 and DS:683A + 0xB8 without normal collision.
blind_spots: Exact two-cel death draw timing still needs frame-by-frame DOSBox validation.
The lives-zero game-over/menu branch is still approximated.
Exact score/ammo/inventory persistence through the restart helper is not fully traced.
next_actions: Extract the death signed-step table into a documented exe_* module with the ASM table offset.
Trace 0x520:0x011A and update reset/persistence semantics.
Capture DOSBox reference frames for death sprite/camera clamp timing.

phases.title: Normal mission horizontal, jump, and fall motion
exact_claims: Horizontal movement uses the EXE-style step ramp and atomic destination probes for normal map collision.
Normal falling uses the 34EA/34AF table and the B8B3 static landing probes.
The upward jump probe is separate from the downward fall probe.
blind_spots: The raw 0x62 dynamic actor/player overlap branch is not fully isolated.
Actor-backed solid fall overlap remains a reconstruction around exact static probes.
Ladder/direct vertical flags DS:6EC3/DS:6EC4 are not implemented.
Difficulty modifiers DS:69B0/DS:69A4 are not modeled.
next_actions: Add deterministic motion probes for wall approach, ceiling hit, edge fall, and landing.
Trace DS:6EC3/DS:6EC4 ladder/direct vertical movement.
Isolate raw 0x62 actor/player branch and compare against current crossing reconstruction.

phases.title: Raw 0xA7 pushable barrel actor interaction
exact_claims: Raw 0xA7 enters a special actor-family branch instead of behaving like a plain static solid tile.
SAM1:0x83C4..0x848A tests player/barrel contact with shrunken X intervals x+3..x+12 for both rectangles and full Y intervals y..y+15.
The runtime uses that ASM rectangle for player/barrel actor overlap, dynamic barrel body collision, and barrel top-contact horizontal eligibility.
The reconstructed vertical fall path keeps X fixed and only uses landing/foot probes; it does not use broad side-body collision to stop falling.
Horizontal barrel pushes still use broad barrel-vs-world collision for the barrel body itself.
Blocked-push release no longer performs an unsupported horizontal counter-nudge; it flips direction and enters a 0x10-tick transient ignore window.
A successful horizontal push that leaves the barrel without floor support marks it unsupported before the next fall tick.
blind_spots: Exact 0x1388 -> 0x1389 animation/draw cleanup is annotated but not implemented as a separate Python actor state.
Score/sound side effects around the helper-hit and player-contact rewrite branches need confirmation in gameplay context.
Blocked-push release is still represented as a transient ignore instead of a full 0x1389 actor state, but pass 120 removed the unsupported horizontal nudge and uses a 0x10 tick window.
No DOSBox reference capture yet for pushing while partially overlapping another dynamic actor.
Pushed-off-edge fall timing and the 0x1389 release/cleanup state remain partial; pass 121 intentionally does not overclaim them as verified.
next_actions: Model state 0x1389 explicitly or prove that the current transient representation is sufficient for gameplay.
Trace helper 0x547C in the raw-0xA7 branch to separate shot/hazard/floor causes from player contact.
Create a tiny DOSBox reference setup for blocked pushes, pushed-off-ledge timing, and barrel/player partial overlap.
Replace release_barrel_against_wall with a full 0x1389 actor-state model once draw/timer semantics are traced.
Trace the exact post-push unsupported transition and compare a pushed-off-edge barrel against a DOSBox reference capture.

phases.title: Level-0 overworld movement, collision, camera, and entrance tick
exact_claims: Level 0 uses the top-down branch when DS:681C == 1.
Movement checks the attempted offset before writing player position.
Collision samples the +0x1CC body byte at player-origin rectangle x+3/x+12 and y/y+15, ignoring +0x1CD.
Camera registers DS:6838/DS:683A use fixed margins rather than a centered camera helper.
blind_spots: Entrance-to-level mapping is still row-major prototype behavior.
Persistent completion/progression flags are not fully traced.
Original popup/table windows are not implemented.
Remaining choke points need coordinate-specific DOSBox comparisons.
next_actions: Trace entrance marker dispatch and completion flag writes.
Implement original table/popup renderer before replacing prototype labels.
Add coordinate-specific overworld movement reference tests.

phases.title: Animated decor and decorative/non-contact policy
exact_claims: Raw 0x40 / object 0x0131 / state 0x2B advances animation counters and does not call the player-contact helper 0x53C4.
The lower cel of raw 0x40 is bank9:1 in the current model.
State 0x2C routes contact through an explicit object-0x0103 helper call.
blind_spots: Frame sources should be generated from renderer/object ranges instead of hand-coded refs.
The full raw 0x78 frame-source family still needs a focused renderer-table audit.
Decor/hazard naming should be split so non-contact animated tiles do not inherit hazard assumptions.
next_actions: Annotate state 0x2B/0x2C ASM branches next to renderer frame sources.
Generate frame-source tables from the original renderer data.
Add regression fixtures for raw 0x40 and raw 0x78 contact expectations.

phases.title: Projectile, enemy contact, and hit policy tick
exact_claims: Ceiling laser state 0x21 has a strict player-origin x gate and uses actor_y+8 for spawned laser origin.
0x00C7 is rewritten to object 0x72/state 0x89 for ceiling beams.
Object 0x72 state 0x25 and state 0x89 have separated damage outcomes in the current runtime.
Stationary launcher states 0x0A/0x0B keep DS:34DA as an elapsed timer that increments before row/facing gates and resets only after a successful helper-0x5784 spawn.
Raw 0x52/state 0x0A fires object 0x01D6 at actor_x+8, actor_y, direction +1, speed 4 when actor_x < player_x and the row gate matches.
Raw 0x51/state 0x0B fires object 0x01D6 at actor_x-8, actor_y, direction -1, speed 4 when actor_x > player_x and the row gate matches.
Raw 0x51/0x52 actor bodies are not solid player blockers and do not hurt on body contact; their threat is projectile 0x01D6.
Stationary launcher helper 0x5784 receives actor_y; Python stores projectile.y = actor_y+7 only to compensate horizontal-projectile rendering at y-7.
Raw 0x51/0x52 stationary launchers are excluded from the generic body-touch fallback; only their emitted 0x01D6 projectile is hostile.
blind_spots: The full projectile object/state table is incomplete.
Impact spark versus silent projectile consumption is only partially separated.
Object-0x72 foreground redraw and map-collision side effects are approximate.
The related raw 0x3C/0x3D stationary launcher body policy and render anchor still need a separate audit.
The generic enemy-body contact fallback is still exclusion-based; it needs a full ASM-derived allowlist so new actor kinds do not inherit damage accidentally.
next_actions: Build a complete projectile object/state table from ASM helper 0x5784 and dispatcher branches.
Add a projectile-policy regression script similar to the barrel/death checks.
Trace object-0x72 map-collision foreground redraw side effects.
Capture DOSBox row-boundary tests for raw 0x51/0x52 launchers after the firing cadence fix.
Audit check_enemy_touch() against the ASM contact dispatcher and turn the temporary exclusion list into a verified allowlist.
